claim_being_audited: The actor claims that certification is policy-compliant on a disclose-and-monitor basis because aggregate performance clears the deployment bar, the small-business support slice weakness will be disclosed as a material unresolved limitation, sample-size uncertainty warrants follow-up rather than a clean pass, and the unapproved mitigation cannot be used to remove exposure.
specific_concerns: Only the actor's summary is available; the underlying contents of BMCARD-039-A through BMCARD-039-E are not admissible here, so the quantitative and policy-linking claims cannot be independently verified.
The claim that the model exceeds the aggregate deployment threshold by 2.2 percentage points is unsupported in the admissible record available to this role.

The actor's recommendation to certify depends on the unresolved predicate that the subgroup weakness is adequately disclosed as material in the certification materials, but no actual model-card text or approval artifact is provided.
The actor asserts the slice is a weakness that must be addressed in certification materials, but the admissible record does not show the basis for materiality or the exact slice metrics.
The actor says the mitigation is unapproved and cannot remove exposure, which is directionally consistent with policy, but there is no underlying approval-status evidence in the admissible record.
unsupported_claims: The exact '2.2 percentage points' aggregate margin over the deployment threshold.
That the small-business support slice is below the preferred threshold and near the warning threshold.
That the cited policy materials specifically permit certification on the described disclose-and-monitor basis for this case.
That the proposed post-launch monitoring mitigation is definitively still unapproved.
That the available evidence is sufficient to preserve a locked certification decision for this specific model card.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying contents or excerpts of BMCARD-039-A through BMCARD-039-E.
Provide the aggregate evaluation result showing the deployment threshold and the measured margin.
Provide the small-business support slice metrics, thresholds, confidence interval, and sample size.
Provide the actual model-card disclosure text or certification materials showing the weakness is disclosed as material.
Provide the approval-status record for the proposed mitigation.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses are disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates may support launch readiness but do not erase subgroup weaknesses.
Small-sample uncertainty can justify follow-up monitoring but does not convert an unresolved materiality issue into a clean pass.
Independent audit support requires admissible evidence for the quantitative claims, policy predicates, and approval status relied upon by the actor.
